headlines.title: Intel (INTC) Sees $79.2 Million in Net ETF Buying on Nov. 11
headlines.summary: 54 ETFs bought Intel shares while 11 sold, for a net inflow of $79.2 million.

headlines.title: Intel (INTC) Could Be 88% Undervalued Following AI Partnerships And Sector Volatility
headlines.summary: Intel (INTC) has been pulled in two directions lately. New collaborations in AI infrastructure and edge computing land alongside sharp sector swings tied to Nvidia’s CEO exit, as well as fresh governance and geopolitical headlines. Recent trading shows how conflicted investors are about Intel. The 1-day share price return of 7.52% and 7-day gain of 19.62% follow a 30-day share price decline of 39.21%. At the same time, the year-to-date share price return is 58.

headlines.title: Intel, RadixArk Collaborate to Advance Open AI Inference on Intel Platforms
After Intel’s Worst Day on Record, CEO Lip-Bu Tan Buys $9.7 Million in Stock
headlines.summary: Intel’s CEO made his second open-market purchase of the year following the stock’s worst single-day percentage drop on record.

headlines.title: Intel Stocks Fall 3.49% as NVIDIA CEO Exit Clouds a $13 Billion Partnership Stake
headlines.summary: NVIDIA's 214.78 million Intel shares are worth about $13 billion, but the joint chip roadmap now answers to new leadership.

description: Intel Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and services computing and related end products and services in the United States, Ireland, Israel, and internationally. It operates through three segments: CCG, DCAI, and Intel Foundry. The company offers client computing group products, including client and commercial CPUs, discrete client GPUs, edge computing, and connectivity products; data center and AI products, such as server CPUs, discrete GPUs, and networking products; and semiconductors comprising wafer fabrication, substrates, and other related products and services. It also provides driving assistance and self-driving solutions; and develops and manufactures multi-beam mask writing tools. The company sells its products through sales organizations, distributors, resellers, retailers, and OEM partners. It serves original equipment manufacturers, original design manufacturers, cloud service providers, and other manufacturers and service providers. Intel Corporation has a strategic collaboration with Infosys Limited to develop a multi-layer AI fabric that unifies infrastructure, models, data, applications, and workflows into a composable and agent-ready ecosystem. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
